info.title: AIVale workspace creation eligibility
info.description: P01-T08c adds a minimal read projection for the workbench create entry. API-002 still checks live ownership independently on every submission and replay.

get.description: No query parameters or bare question mark accepted. Uses only the authenticated subject's current Team membership and owner user ID. Both ownership facts must agree. Workspace/global admin roles are insufficient. Ineligible subjects receive false and null without Team metadata. Platform defaults off.

200.description: Current eligibility; the Team ID is present only for an eligible owner.

401.description: No current valid dashboard session; PAT, model Token and Cookie alone do not qualify.

500.description: Current eligibility could not be verified.

503.description: The Agent platform gate is closed.

DashboardSession.description: Existing dashboard access JWT backed by a live login session.

RequestID.description: Server-owned ID equal to the JSON request_id.
